topology_edges.conditional_mechanism: If the labor market is strong, then labor market indicators may reflect this strength.
If labor market indicators suggest strength, then consumer demand may be supported.
If consumer demand is robust, then industrial activity conditions may be influenced.
If the labor market is strong, then manufacturing employment may be growing.
If manufacturing employment is growing, then industrial activity conditions may be influenced.
If industrial activity conditions are conducive, then monthly industrial-production growth may be affected.
If the manufacturing sector outlook is recessionary, then monthly industrial-production growth may be inhibited.
